reason: $24.99 for the first box is a launch price I can take a chance on, and the empty-box refund means I do not lose money if I feel nothing. The named lab report I can check makes it feel less sketchy than the usual TikTok Shop stuff.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium might do nothing for my sleep and I would have spent $25 I do not have to spare.
would_change_my_mind: If the price were still $29.99 with no launch deal, or if the lab report on the page was not real or did not match the batch number, I would skip it.
